name: Kevin Seto
bio: Kevin leads analytics and project delivery at Alphabyte Solutions, helping businesses harness the power of data to identify opportunities for improvement and drive strategic decisions. He develops comprehensive BI roadmaps and data-driven strategies that enhance operations, boost revenue, and reduce costs.

His background spans e-commerce analytics, financial planning, and international investment operations — from Standard Chartered Bank in Hong Kong to leading analytics delivery across North American clients at Alphabyte.
